# Cincy Crash Data

```{r cincy_crashes}
crashes_per_day = 30125 / 365
crashes_per_day 

crashes_by_day = c(2020, 2241, 2327, 2285,
                   2380, 1866, 1664)
names(crashes_by_day) = c("Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu",
                          "Fri", "Sat", "Sun")
crashes_by_day

crashes_by_day > 2100
```

## Type of `crashes_by_day`

```{r typeof_vec}
typeof(crashes_by_day)

crashes_by_day_int = c(2020L, 2241L, 2327L, 2285L, 2380L, 1866L, 1664L)
names(crashes_by_day_int) = c("Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun")

typeof(crashes_by_day_int)

```
